marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots diminishing to south 15 late this
morning then veering to west 15 early this afternoon. Wind backing to southwest
20 early this evening then veering to west 25 late this evening. Wind
diminishing to light Monday afternoon. Scattered flurries beginning this afternoon changing to
snow this evening then to scattered flurries Monday morning. Fog patches forming
late this morning and dissipating early this afternoon. Temperatures minus 1 falling to minus 8 Monday
evening. <br/>
